abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: Convention: every class ships a free rank-1 Attack.

abilities.name: Malefic Wrath
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'when you cast Malefic Wrath and Loa's Brew the ward will also cast it on your target'. The class's baseline Shadow nuke, on shaman_lightning_bolt's exact 9-rank curve.

abilities.name: Loa's Brew
abilities.description: Heals an ally.
abilities._source: CoA class tree names Loa's Brew alongside Malefic Wrath as what Mimic Ward echoes, and it is not a talent node in any of the three spec trees, so it is a class ability. Voodoo's page says that spec has 'no ally heal' - true of its TREE, which spends nothing on healing.

abilities.name: Shrinking Jinx
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Attack Power -45 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'When your Shrinking Jinx is dispelled it now applies Misery to the dispeller'. The jinx itself shrinks what the target can swing.

abilities.name: Hex of Malice
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to the target over time for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Curse an enemy, dealing shadow damage and an additional 96 Shadow damage over 24 seconds.' The DoT all three specs keep rolling - warlock_corruption's curve.
abilities._level_note: Rank 1 moved from level 8 to 4, 29 Oct 2026. Kyle's call on the early-game finding: the class was soft at levels 5-20 and fine from 30, and the cause was how FEW damage buttons it had early rather than how hard they hit. Values unchanged at every rank, so nothing moves at 60.

abilities.name: Healing Ward
abilities.description: Heals your party over time for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Drop a Healing Ward near you for 1 minute, healing 8 nearby allies within 30 yds for Spirit every 3 sec'. Both DPS specs' pages call this the class pool's only ally heal. A placed, pulsing ward becomes an instant party HoT, the same simplification every shipped Shaman totem uses.

abilities.name: Lethargy Jinx
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Haste -25, Healing Taken Pct -20% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Jinx of Decay - Your Lethargy Jinx now also reduces the target's periodic healing received by -30%'. healing_taken_pct is the engine's real anti-heal key, read recipient-side in Character.heal.

abilities.name: Hexbreak
abilities.description: Removes 1 curse effect from an ally.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Dispel duty is single-curse removal through Hexbreak'. 'Blessing of Hir'eek - Your Hexbreak now removes an additional curse effect' is the class tree's dispel_count upgrade, which is a talent, not this.

abilities.name: Mirage
abilities.description: Threat generated -60%, Dodge +10 for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Become invisible for 20 seconds, gaining 5 Spirits, leaving a copy of yourself behind, and reducing threat each second.' Both DPS pages call the class's escapes 'threat drops, they do not move you', so this is threat and avoidance rather than a blink.

abilities.name: Shadowflare
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to up to 5 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'spread Hex of Malice with Shadowflare', 'Dealing damage with Shadowflare now applies Hex of Malice if it strikes at least 3 enemies'. The shared AoE. NOTE: the engine's AoE flag is target_type='enemy_aoe' plus max_targets - a player Ability never reads is_aoe, which _ability_from_data does not pass to the constructor.

abilities.name: Vol'jin's Vigil
abilities.description: Damage taken -25% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Embrace the way of Vol'jin, reducing your damage taken by -25% and healing you for 2% of your maximum health every 1 sec for 10 seconds.' Both halves are real: the mitigation as a stat_mod, the trickle as an on_damage_taken heal proc on the resulting buff.

abilities.name: Amphibimorph
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns the target for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Transform enemies at target location into a frog, making them unable to attack or cast spells, and slowing their movement speed'. is_stun is the engine's real skip-their-turn flag (TurnMeter refuses to fill for a stunned combatant).

abilities.name: Allcure Elixir
abilities.description: Removes 1 poison/disease effect from an ally.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Allcure Elixir clears poison, disease and curse effects off one ally'. Curse is already Hexbreak's job, so this covers the other two rather than making Hexbreak redundant. 'For Da Loa!' upgrades it to the group-wide Mass Allcure Elixir, which is a class-tree pick, not this.

abilities.name: Slither
abilities.description: Dodge +25, Haste +15 for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Transform into a serpent, removing all movement impairing effects and increasing movement speed by 80% ... chance to be hit by ranged attacks and spells is reduced'. No movement-impairment category exists on the player side, so the avoidance half carries the node.

abilities.name: Stasis Ward
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns up to 4 targets for 1 turn.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Touch of Mueh'zala - Increases the duration of Stasis Ward's stun effect by 1 sec', so the ward stuns. The class's only AoE stun.

abilities.name: Swift Idol
abilities.description: Grants your party: Haste +12, Dodge +5 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Drop a Swift Idol near you for 10 seconds. Allies within 30 yds gain 25% increased movement speed and their chance to resist movement impairing effects is increased'. Movement speed has no combat meaning in a turn engine, so it lands as Haste, which is what moving faster buys.

abilities.name: Mimic Ward
abilities.description: Shadow Spell Power +25, Spell Power +15 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Summon a mimic ward for 12 seconds. For the duration when you cast Malefic Wrath and Loa's Brew the ward will also cast it on your target.' There is no repeat-my-last-cast mechanic in the engine, so the window lands as the spell power the echo would have been worth. The cast-echo is the one part of this kit with no honest equivalent.

abilities.name: Cursed Effigy
abilities.description: Grants your party: Physical damage taken -8%, Magic damage taken -8% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Drop a Cursed Effigy near you for 15 seconds. Enemies within 15 yds are unable to critically strike.' GAP: a monster's crit_chance is a plain template attribute (entities/monster.py) that no status effect touches, so crit suppression has no hook at all. Implemented from the other side - the party takes less damage, which is what losing enemy crits is worth.

abilities.name: Power Wuju
abilities.description: Grants your party: Spell Power +30, Attack Power +30, Spirit +8 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Loa Empowerment - Reduces the cost of your Wujus by -50% and increases the effectiveness of Power Wuju by 20%'. A Wuju is a thrown buff, so it buffs both halves of a party.

abilities.name: Death Draught
abilities.description: Damage taken -50%, Threat generated -100% for 1 turn.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Drink a potent voodoo draught that slows your body to a deathlike stillness ... causing you to feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you.' No feign-death mechanic exists, so one turn of heavy mitigation and a total threat drop stands in for it. Free to cast, like the real one.

abilities.name: Veil of Darkness
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Damage taken +12% for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Envelop a target in a shadowy voodoo veil, increasing the damage you deal to them by 15% for 15 seconds.' damage_taken_pct on the target is read raw as a fraction in Character.take_damage. It amplifies everyone's damage, not only yours - the engine has no per-attacker-only amplification.

abilities.name: Big Bad Voodoo
abilities.description: Grants your party: Damage taken -30%, Damage dealt -25% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'One Armed Waltz - Big Bad Voodoo now only reduces damage dealt by 25% and reduces damage taken by an additional -5%', which says the baseline trades your damage for survival. Both sides are real keys: damage_taken_pct raw, damage_dealt_pct in percentage points through Ability._damage_multiplier.

abilities.name: Bad Juju
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Bad Juju on cooldown (main nuke ...)'. 'Hurl a bolt of dark magic at an enemy, dealing Spirit Shadow damage, scaling with your Spirit.' The spec's centrepiece.
abilities._level_note: Rank 1 moved from level 10 to 8, 29 Oct 2026. Kyle's call on the early-game finding: the class was soft at levels 5-20 and fine from 30, and the cause was how FEW damage buttons it had early rather than how hard they hit. Values unchanged at every rank, so nothing moves at 60.

abilities.name: Hexfire
abilities.description: Deals Fire damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Blast an enemy with hexfire, dealing Fire damage, scaling with your Spirit'; 'Detonate Puppeteer's Threads with Hexfire for burst'. The thread-snap has no engine hook, so Hexfire is a straight Fire payoff nuke.

abilities.name: Shadow Puppets
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to the target over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Summon a Shadow Puppet that collects a Spirit and rushes towards your target, dealing shadow damage, repeating every 1 sec for 3 seconds.' A summon whose whole job is three ticks of damage on one target, so it is a spell_dot rather than a pet - see the module docstring on why no summon_pet template fits.

abilities.name: Malignant Jinx
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Damage dealt -30% for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Curse an enemy for 8 seconds, causing their next spell cast to silence them for 5 sec'; 'Malignant Jinx counters a dangerous cast with a silence'. GAP: there is no silence or school-lockout category, and is_stun would make this a stun, which it is not. A hard cut to what they deal is the nearest honest thing.

abilities.name: War Golem
abilities.description: Magic damage taken -10% for 2 turns, absorbing damage.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Summon a War Golem for 10 seconds, absorbing damage dealt to you based on your Intellect, and redirecting harmful spells cast on nearby allies to itself.' The absorb is real (absorb_pct_max_health, the same field Cultist's Eldritch Bastion uses). The ally-spell redirect has no engine hook, so the magic mitigation stands in for it.

abilities.name: Puppeteer's Grasp
abilities.description: Makes your next cast instant.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Transform into a malignant spirit for 30 seconds, allowing you to cast Malefic Wrath and Bad Juju while moving, and periodically granting you a Spirit every 2 sec.' Nothing in the engine costs movement, so cast-while-moving becomes the real thing it buys: the next cast is free of its turn.

abilities.name: Voice of Bwonsamdi
abilities.description: Shadow Spell Power +40, Spell crit chance +8, Damage dealt +15% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Let the spirit of Bwonsamdi possess you for 15 seconds. Dealing periodic damage unleashes a trapped voodoo spirit at enemies'; 'Voice of Bwonsamdi is your big damage cooldown'.

abilities.name: Potion Toss
abilities.description: Heals an ally.
abilities._source: CoA: 'the instant, short-cooldown Potion Toss'; 'Fill a potion from your Cauldron, and toss it at a friendly target'. Splash On 'Em shaves its cooldown, which is why it ships at 3 turns and not 1.

abilities.name: Spirit in a Bottle
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target and heals you for part of it.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Spirit in a Bottle heals an ally while chipping and debuffing nearby enemies off the same cast, functionally the same trick as Living Flame'. damage_and_heal is cast at an ENEMY and heals off the damage, which is exactly this shape.

abilities.name: Splash Potion
abilities.description: Heals your party.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Fill a splash potion from your Cauldron, and toss it at a location, healing up to 8 allies'; 'Use Splash Potion for stacked-group healing'.

abilities.name: Mojo Beam
abilities.description: Heals an ally over time for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Bring mojo to an ally, healing for SP every 1 sec for 4 seconds. While channeling, you can instantly cast Potion Toss, Splash Potion and Spirit in a Bottle'. GAP: there is no channel state, so the weave window is gone and this is a four-turn single-target HoT - which is what the channel's healing actually was.

abilities.name: Ingredient: Jungle Shrooms
abilities.description: Heals your party over time for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Brew Jungle Shrooms into your Cauldron. Cauldron: Heal up to 8 allies within 30 yds for healing every 8 sec'; 'a rolling Jungle Shrooms heal-over-time'. The three Ingredients share one exclusive_group because CoA says 'Only 1 of each Ingredient can be active at a time' and the Mojo swap talents swap them in pairs.

abilities.name: Ingredient: Frog Bones
abilities.description: Grants your party: Damage taken -6% for 4 turns, absorbing damage.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Cauldron: Grants allies within 40 yds 3% reduced damage taken. Potion: Grants target ally an absorption shield, absorbing Spirit damage.' Both halves are real here - the mitigation and the shield.

abilities.name: Ingredient: Bloodthistle
abilities.description: Grants your party: Healing Taken Pct +8% for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Cauldron: Allies within 40 yds receive 8% increased healing. Potion: Causes target ally to leech 5% of all damage they deal.' Both halves are real: healing_taken_pct recipient-side, and leech_pct, the engine's own damage-done-also-heals proc payload.

abilities.name: Voodoo Cauldron
abilities.description: Grants your party: Healing Taken Pct +20%, Mp5 +4 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Place down a Voodoo Cauldron for 15 seconds, increasing allies' healing received by 20% while near the cauldron'; 'drop Voodoo Cauldron ... on the tank's stack point'. The heals-received zone is a real key; the pulse is Jungle Shrooms' job and not duplicated here.

abilities.name: Base: Beast Blood
abilities.description: Grants your party: Physical damage taken -15% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Infuse your Cauldron with Beast Blood for 10 seconds, causing 15% of the direct Physical damage taken by allies within 40 yds to instead be dealt over time. Only 1 Base can be active at a time.' GAP: there is no convert-a-hit-into-a-DoT mechanic, so the 15% is simply removed rather than deferred. The two Bases share an exclusive_group, as CoA requires.

abilities.name: Base: Crystal Water
abilities.description: Clean water in the base. Everything you heal leaves a skin behind it.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Infuse your Cauldron with Crystal Water for 10 seconds, causing allies within 40 yds to be shielded for 20% of their healing taken'. Shield-off-healing has no hook, so the shield is sized off the recipient's own health instead - same field, honest magnitude.

abilities.name: Tiki Splash
abilities.description: Heals your party.
abilities._source: CoA lists Tiki Splash among Brewing's 23-TE tier-6 picks with no tooltip text ('see builder tooltip'), so the name is real and the mechanic is read off its slot: the spec's emergency group heal, which the rotation otherwise lacks ('Hold Master Mixologist as the group heal-burst and wipe-prevention amplify window').

abilities.name: Master Mixologist
abilities.description: Healing Power Pct +40%, Haste +10 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'For 10 seconds, the effectiveness of all Cauldron effects and Ingredients is increased by 100% and you can cast Spirit in a Bottle while moving.' healing_power_pct takes percentage POINTS (one of the ten keys Character._recalculate_derived_stats divides by 100), so 40 is +40%, not +4000%.

abilities.name: Reclamation
abilities.description: Deals Nature damage to the target and restores some of your mana.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Shoot a quick voodoo arrow at an enemy dealing 100% Ranged Weapon Damage plus 15 as Nature damage and collecting a Spirit. Spirit: Regenerates 7 health and mana ... Usable while moving.' Spirits are not a resource in CLASS_RESOURCE_MAP, so the Spirit collection is a real Mana return - 4% of 1085 at level 60 against a 30-ish cost, which is the net-positive filler CoA describes.

abilities.name: Malefic Arrow
abilities.description: Deals Nature damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Transforms your Malefic Wrath into Malefic Arrow. Launch a voodoo arrow at an enemy, dealing 85% Ranged Weapon Damage plus nature SP as Nature damage, healing you equal to 40% of the damage dealt.' The self-heal is the class tree's Devotion to Bwonsamdi, so it lives in the tree as a leech proc rather than being baked in twice.

abilities.name: Spirit Glaive
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to up to 3 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Toss spectral glaives that strikes enemies it passes through, dealing shadow damage, and reducing their Shadow Resistance by 61 for 5 seconds. Usable while moving.' The resistance shred would need a debuff on top of a damage cast, which no single effect_type does, so the pass-through cleave carries the ability.

abilities.name: Spirit Shock
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Haste -45, Damage dealt -20% for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Shock an enemy's spirit, silencing them for 4 seconds and interrupting non-player spellcasting'. GAP: no silence or interrupt category exists. A heavy Haste cut is the engine's real delay-their-turn lever (TurnMeter reads Haste off status effects), which is the closest thing to taking a cast away from them.

abilities.name: Call of Sseratus
abilities.description: Deals Nature damage to up to 4 targets over time for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Summon 4 Serpent Wards near you for 15 seconds'; 'Drop your Serpent Wards before or on the pull so they add sustained damage through the fight.' Placed pulsing wards become an AoE spell_dot, exactly as shaman_magma_totem does, and not a summon_pet - see the module docstring.

abilities.name: Spirit Eclipse
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to up to 4 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Unleash your Spirits on an enemy, dealing shadow damage for each active Spirit. Each Spirit explodes on impact, dealing damage to other nearby enemies.' Without a Spirit stack to scale off, it is a fixed hard-hitting cleave on a cooldown rather than a variable dump.

abilities.name: Shadowstalker
abilities.description: Dodge +30, Haste +15, Threat generated -80% for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Disappear into darkness, entering an improved stealth mode, clearing all harmful effects, and increasing movement speed by 50%'. GAP: a buff cannot also dispel, so the clear-all-harmful-effects half is gone - which matters, because CoA calls it 'the entire answer to CC' for this spec. The disengage half is real.

abilities.name: Shadow Avatar
abilities.description: Damage dealt +12%, Haste +10 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Lesser Shadow Avatar - Increases magic damage dealt by 10% and reduces the cooldown of Spirit Glaive by 20% every 1 sec'; 'then Shadow Avatar ... and Fool's Play'. damage_dealt_pct is school-agnostic in this engine (see Ability._damage_multiplier), so 'magic damage dealt' lands as all damage dealt.

abilities.name: Frenzied Spirits
abilities.description: Physical crit chance +10, Spell crit chance +10 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Consumes your Spirits to increase your ranged critical strike rating by 10, critical damage by 5%, and causing you to heal for 2% of all damage dealt for each Spirit consumed.' The crit and the leech are both real; crit_damage_physical is NOT - it is read only through get_talent_effect, so it does nothing in a buff's stat_mods and is left to the tree instead.
